confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from crowd-sourced Expatistan figures for Sofia (beer, cappuccino, cocktail, pub dinner for two, Italian dinner for two) and a secondary French site citing Numbeo-based lunch averages. Lev amounts are converted at the euro peg of 1.95583 BGN per EUR, using an assumed EUR/USD of about 1.15 because I found no reliable October 2026 rate. Inexpensive meal, mid-range meal and wine glass are bounded estimates: the mid-range figure excludes the wine from the two-person Italian dinner, and the wine glass is inferred from a retail bottle price plus an assumed restaurant markup. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the Sofia context. No accommodation search was run, so they are low confidence. The FX value is the RBA 4pm observation for 15 Oct 2026. The RBA exchange-rates page also lists 16 Oct 2026 at 0.6947, but I could not confirm that as an official 4pm observation, so I did not use it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink anchors are based on Sofia-specific price data. Accommodation anchors are benchmarked to general budget and mid-range capital-city levels in Southeast and Central Europe, from model knowledge rather than live listings.
